items.name: CellOffsets
items.summary: Cell offsets are used to keep track of the start and end offsets of each cell in the concatenated source code. These offsets are in sorted order.

methods.name: containing_range
methods.summary: Returns the range of the cell containing the given offset, if any.

methods.name: content_ranges
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over the concatenated source ranges covered by each cell's actual contents, excluding Ruff's synthetic trailing newline separator.

methods.name: has_cell_boundary
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the given range contains a cell boundary.

methods.name: ranges
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over [`TextRange`]s covered by each cell.
